feeds.title: Budget Bytes
feeds.description: Providing easy recipes made with simple ingredients that will keep you full, happy, and within your budget with step by step photos for every recipe! Beth hopes to give confidence to new cooks and help inspire people to learn how to cook and reduce their dependence on the prepared food industry.

feeds.title: Don't Waste the Crumbs Blog
feeds.description: Covers all things grocery budgeting, meal planning, money saving hacks, tips and tricks and easy DIY's. Don't Waste the Crumbs is all about helping people save money and eat real food.

feeds.title: A Mind 'Full' Mom - Real Food. Real Families. Real Budget
feeds.description: Easy, healthy meals that your whole family will love. Sharing recipes that are family friendly and budget friendly.

feeds.title: Good Cheap Eats - eat well. act your wage. enjoy life.
feeds.description: I want to help you make the most of what you have. Check out my money-saving strategies, easy meal plans, and budget-friendly recipes. Recipes, kitchen tips,freezer cooking inspiration, and restaurant reviews to help you eat well, act your wage, and enjoy life. Brought to you by FishMama and Friends.

feeds.title: Plant Based on a Budget
feeds.description: Browse Recipes, Meal Plans, Desserts, Drinks, Snacks and more. The goal of Plant Based on a Budget blog is that everyone should be able to cook delicious, healthy vegan food without spending a fortune.

feeds.title: Budget Savvy Diva
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sara. I am a wife, lifestyle, and food blogger. I am Budget Savvy Diva ( Sara Sicotte Lundberg). Here you will find easy recipes and more. If you love saving money, finding new and healthy recipes, and researching the latest products, you're in the right place.

feeds.title: Budget Savvy Diva » Frugal Eats
feeds.description: If you love saving money, finding new and healthy recipes, and researching the latest products, you're in the right place. Created by Sara Lundberg, this section of the Budget Savvy Diva covers budget recipes and a frugal lifestyle.

feeds.title: $5 Dinners Blog
feeds.description: I'm Erin Chase. I'm on a mission to help you spend less on groceries! To make dinner for my family every night for $5 or less! My mission is to prepare healthy meals using natural and wholesome ingredients!

feeds.title: Graceful Little Honey Bee
feeds.description: Hi! Im Missy. Im a stay-at-home mom of two who has a heart for encouraging women to live a simple and frugal life. Grow your own food. Cook from scratch. Save money.

feeds.title: Frugal Family Home » Food
feeds.description: Make your wallet happy while keeping your family fed and happy too. It's easy to do with quick and easy recipes, kitchen hacks and cooking and baking tips.

feeds.title: Pocket Change Gourmet
feeds.description: Pocket Change Gourmet was born out of a desire to share our passions of cooking for our family using easy, creative recipes and saving money at the same time.

feeds.title: Olive & Mango
feeds.description: A budget-conscious lifestyle blog on food, travel, and well-being.

feeds.title: The Stingy Vegan
feeds.description: I am Melissa and I am stingy. I hate spending money. I am vegan. Meat is expensive and beans are cheap! If you're living (or considering) a plant-based lifestyle and you're on a budget or stingy like me, you're in the right place. I'll break down the total cost and cost per serving of each of my recipes to show any naysayer that a vegan diet isn't expensive!

feeds.title: Frugal Nutrition
feeds.description: Simple, Delicious, Nutritious, and Frugal Recipes for Everyday Cooks! Frugal Nutrition is a Baltimore-based food blog where the author Caitlin combines everything she knows about food & nutrition with everything about being broke!

feeds.title: Frugal Foodie Mama
feeds.description: A budget conscious, foodie mama blogging about the food I love to make, motherhood, and our family friendly travels. Sharing tasty and budget friendly recipes, money saving tips, and our love for family friendly travel.

feeds.title: Cheap Recipe Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Haley! I am here to show you that cheap cooking can be really, really good. You can eat well and on a budget. With a little planning and creativity, you can start saving money on cooking while still eating really great food. I know because I do it all the time!

feeds.title: Frugal Foodie Mama
feeds.description: Tasty & budget friendly recipes, money saving tips, and family friendly travel

feeds.title: Penny's Recipes - Everyday, Easy Recipes For Busy People
feeds.description: Hi I'm Penny. I created Penny's Recipes to share my favourite simple, fresh and economical recipes for you to cook. I know what it is to lead a busy life and to want great meals without spending too much time in the kitchen.

feeds.title: Cheapskate Cook
feeds.description: Empowering you to save money and eat healthy. I share quick meal hacks, frugal recipes, and how to cook healthy even if you don't shop at a health food store.

feeds.title: Poor Man's Gourmet Kitchen - Simple recipes at a low budget wonder!
feeds.description: PMGK is packed with Original, Authentic and Restaurant Secret Recipes with amazing Video tutorials that show you exactly how to cook the ingredients.

feeds.title: The Frugal Chef
feeds.description: A blog created to help anyone who is interested in learning how to cook healthy meals on a budget. Authored by MaryAnn Allen. Her desire is to help you get organized, save money on food, and share her recipes with you!

feeds.title: Thrifty Lesley
feeds.description: Thrifty Lesley writes about how to feed yourself for £1 a day. Cheap, healthy and delicious meals. This blog covers meal plans, shopping lists and recipes for 7-day plans. Author Lesley Negus will be posting anything that she thinks can create cheap meals.

feeds.title: Workweek Lunch Blog
feeds.description: Workweek Lunch is a food blog dedicated to helping you save money by cooking more so you have more time and cash for the stuff you love to do. Cooking cheap, healthy food for the workweek is easy

feeds.title: My Plant-Based Family - Whole Food, Plant-Based Diet, On a Budget Blog
feeds.description: My Plant-Based Family provides a Whole Food, Plant-Based Diet, On a Budget. Find Whole Food, Plant-Based (no oil) recipes and tips, Free weekly Meal Plans, Allergy-friendly recipes and tips.

feeds.title: Frugal Recipes
feeds.description: My name is Shannon. I like to save money anywhere I can, because I dont like to give my money away. Serving frugal meals is one way I do this. I am also trying to lose weight, which is necessary for my health. be posting recipes as I am able, sometimes after tweaking them for healthiness when I can afford to.

feeds.title: Paleo On A Budget
feeds.description: A website with tips and tricks for being paleo or gluten free on a budget! Also includes wicked yummy recipes, meal plans, and weekly store deals to help you stay within your budget while eating healthy!

feeds.title: Munaty Cooking
feeds.description: Hello there! I'm Muna, the voice behind this food blog. I'm the writer, editor, cook, food photographer, and videographer at Munaty Cooking food blog. Munaty Cooking is a food blog with budget-friendly and easy dinner recipes. Find delicious southern recipes, scrumptious dessert recipes, and outstanding breakfast ideas.

feeds.title: Once A Month Meals Blog
feeds.description: Once A Month Meals (OAMM) offers customized resources, supportive friends to guide you through a freezer meal plan single cooking day that will give you seasonal freezer meals; saving you time for what matters most!

feeds.title: Cook for Good Save money. Eat well. Make a difference. Blog
feeds.description: Cook for Good is here to help you plan, cook, and eat delicious food for very little money and without too much effort. Get amazing recipes and cooking plans on a food-stamp budget.

feeds.title: Recipes from a Normal Mum
feeds.description: Recipes from a normal mum, on a normal budget, for everyone to enjoy. I've decided to record the recipes I use, partly to save them somewhere and partly in case someone else might like to use them.

feeds.title: Lazy Budget Chef
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Lisa and I am a foodie. This is a food blog about cooking quick healthy recipes on a budget and frugal saving money tips and hacks. I became an accidental foodie when I learned to cook from scratch and on a budget.

feeds.title: The Family Freezer Blog
feeds.description: The Family Freezer provides easy, healthy, and budget-friendly recipes that can be frozen without any cooking ahead of time. It started as a blog dedicated to healthy crockpot recipes that could be frozen without any cooking ahead of time, now teaching live cooking classes, and found they were a lot of fun.

feeds.title: No More Ramen
feeds.description: Easy, budget-friendly recipes for folks with little time and even less money! No More Ramen's aim is to provide an easy to navigate space with lots of options for folks with dietary restrictions and health issues. Here, you'll find a variety of recipes, but what they all have in common is that they're simple to make and the ingredients are not expensive.

feeds.title: Utterly Scrummy Food For Families
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michelle. I am sharing how we eat healthily and heartily on a very tight budget in my blog. Get budget-friendly, easy, tasty food for busy families.

feeds.title: Tiny Budget Cooking Blog
feeds.description: Simplifying your food life with meal plans, shopping lists and personalised recipes all on a tiny budget. Limahl Asmall's Tiny Budget Cooking contains 4 weekly mealplans, price-checked shopping lists, ingredient swaps to personalise recipes and all for a small budget of £21.00 per week.

feeds.title: VeganSandra
feeds.description: My name is Sandra. I'm a long-time vegan and a published cookbook author who lives in the woods and plays drums in a death metal band (Neoandertals). My recipes are tasty, easy, delicious and affordable vegan recipes.

feeds.title: Cheap Cooking
feeds.description: CheapCooking.com will help you learn how to cut your grocery bill. Learn recipes, shopping tips, storage and organization tips, plus chat with other cheap cooking fans in our forum.

feeds.title: Eating Richly - Kid friendly foods rich in nutrition & flavor
feeds.description: Eating Richly is your place for kid friendly foods rich in nutrition and flavor. From healthy recipes, to cute food ideas we've got just what a busy mom needs to make meal time fun!
